newspec-c: passed → passed (passed)
Local Playwright spec newspec-c/an2-oat06-s20-analytics-fail.spec.ts: patientActivity:logDuplicatePrompt and usage:record are refused at the Convex socket for every call while a switch is on (stronger than failFirstMutationRequest, which fails only the first), then the switch is turned off. Judged for TFA-94514 (U3 / U6 / U8), 3/3: once the writes work again a Hospital add-anyway logs duplicate_prompt_shown + duplicate_prompt_rejected (manual, hospital, same promptId) and patient_added; a Nursing Home add-anyway logs the same with nursing_home; a later chart logs pre_round_summary_opened, task_completed and note_marked_complete. Todo, recorded not judged (T2 'silent and backend-only' is TFA-92580, rejected by QA): while the duplicate-prompt log fails, the Hospital re-add of 'QA Hosp OAT06 Fail' (same name and room, OK on the browser's confirm) is refused: the form keeps every typed value and shows 'Could not save the duplicate check — [CONVEX M(patientActivity:logDuplicatePrompt)] …' (the raw server text, the B17 pattern); the Nursing Home re-add is refused with 'The resident couldn't be added. Check your connection and try again.' and keeps the name. The task tap and Mark Encounter Complete go through with no message while usage:record fails, but those two analytics rows are lost (no retry). The refused adds go to Daniela under Q18.

descriptionHtml:
Case priority: P1 · our extension of a stated behaviour · ours: analytics write failure.

Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S20 An analytics write fails: the physician's add, completion and task tap still go through in both contexts, with no analytics message

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 The logging is silent and backend-only: recording an event never interrupts, delays or blocks what the physician is doing (TFA-92580 Analytics) — gate: blocked: TFA-92580 rejected by qa
  • U3 A duplicate-detection prompt logs that it was shown, and logs whether the physician accepted or rejected it (manual add and scan, both contexts) (UAT OAT-06 Test 3; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 1; TFA-92580 AC 7; TFA-92580 AC 5)
  • U6 Completing an encounter fires both timestamps (Pre-Round summary opened, note marked complete), and they aggregate per physician per day (UAT OAT-06 Test 5; UAT 3.3; TFA-94514 AC 4)
  • U8 Completing a task and deleting a task are logged as separate events; task reminders are tracked live (completed vs deleted logged separately) (UAT OAT-06 Test 7; UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 1; UAT TC-24; TFA-94514 AC 2)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fresh physician; Hospital patient 'QA Hosp OAT06 Fail' (room 4B-63) note-ready with one task, and Nursing Home resident 'QA Resident OAT06 Fail'; the harness fails every patientActivity:logDuplicatePrompt and usage:record call at the Convex socket

When Re-add 'QA Hosp OAT06 Fail' with the same room and answer OK (add anyway); open the existing chart, complete its task, Mark Encounter Complete. In Nursing Home, re-add 'QA Resident OAT06 Fail' and answer OK

Then A second 'QA Hosp OAT06 Fail' is on the list, the task shows done and the encounter complete; a second 'QA Resident OAT06 Fail' is on the Nursing Home list; no message about analytics, a 'duplicate check' or a resident that couldn't be added interrupts; when the socket works again later events are logged normally

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TFA-92580 Analytics 'silent and backend-only' (T2, gated: a Fail reports as Blocked on TFA-92580), cross-referenced to Empty & Failure States 'Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost' and OAT-03 'the original input is never lost'. cp1 mustContain the name and mustNotContain 'duplicate check' and the add form; …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-06.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 8b4be94a (10-20), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

Todo, recorded not judged (T2 'silent and backend-only' is TFA-92580, rejected by QA): while the duplicate-prompt log fails, the Hospital re-add of 'QA Hosp OAT06 Fail' (same name and room, OK on the browser's confirm) is refused: the form keeps every typed value and shows 'Could not save the duplicate check — [CONVEX M(patientActivity:logDuplicatePrompt)] …' (the raw server text, the B17 pattern); the Nursing Home re-add is refused with 'The resident couldn't be added. Check your connection and try again.' and keeps the name. The task tap and Mark Encounter Complete go through with no message while usage:record fails, but those two analytics rows are lost (no retry). The refused adds go to Daniela under Q18.
